scope.reviewedText: all supplied chapter sections, appendix, and symbol index; unavailable pages remain explicit source gaps

semantics.declarations: Typed, builder-independent objects and author-supplied propositions. Predicates have no automatic inference. A DSL vocabulary route does not imply an implementation of a decision procedure.
semantics.finiteHelpers: Validated actual finite models with Set/Map identity equality, not a truncation theorem for infinite spaces.
semantics.geometry: Mathematical entities are independent of Style; figure-specific geometric subclasses coexist with shape-free coarse declarations.
semantics.composition: declareSetTheory is the small shared base; declareElementarySetTheory is full Chapter 1; declareGroupTheory is reusable algebra; declareTopologicalVocabulary creates its group vocabulary, or declareTopologicalVocabularyWithGroups reuses existing algebra. All declarations must be in the same builder.
semantics.sourceNotation: Source LaTeX in entity labels, with matching semantic predicates. There is no parser for arbitrary set-builder syntax or quantifiers.
limits: No reconstruction of missing definitions or pages.
Infinite countability, compactness, completeness, and homotopy facts require author-supplied mathematical justification. Finite sample tests do not prove them.
Higher homotopy, homology and cohomology are named background topics in the conclusion; declarations identify them, without inventing absent definitions or calculating these groups.
A raw numeric metadata object is a typed assertion, not a proof; use validated helper data where provided.
Equal induced homomorphisms require a based/relative homotopy; the source omission in §11.4 Proposition 8 is documented.
Continuous/metric formulas preserve source inconsistencies in transcriptions; helpers implement explicitly stated mathematics, not invalid proof steps.
